research_goal: Create backend-ready wrestling top, bottom, riding, turning, par terre, mat return, escape, reversal, and defensive-position knowledge for SFTC.

technical_principles.summary: Top control starts with controlling hips, wrists, pressure, angles, and mat returns. Turns or near-fall/exposure attempts should come from broken base and controlled pressure, not random force.
Bottom wrestling starts with building base, protecting from turns, winning hand control, creating hip separation, and choosing stand-up, sit-out, switch, or reversal paths.
Freestyle and Greco par terre require quick conversion to turns or strong defense because scoring windows and restart pressures are different from folkstyle riding.
Mat returns should control lift, direction, hip position, opponent safety, and follow-up control. Beginners need low-amplitude return mechanics before live mat-return work.

priorities: par terre gut-wrench or lace awareness when style-appropriate
avoid_until_ready: advanced leg rides with knee/hip/ankle irritation
live mat returns without safe landing skill
fatigue-based top/bottom rounds when technique collapses

priorities: quick par terre conversion for freestyle and Greco
avoid_until_ready: high-volume hard mat wrestling with neck, rib, shoulder, or back symptoms

common_errors: riding with arms only and losing hip pressure
chasing turns before breaking the base
bottom athlete standing without hand control
rolling blindly and exposing the back
mat returning without controlling direction or landing
using freestyle par terre logic in folkstyle riding without adapting goals
using folkstyle riding logic in freestyle when quick exposure matters
safety_constraints: Regress hard top/bottom rounds with neck, shoulder, rib, low-back, knee, or hip symptoms.
Do not prescribe high-amplitude mat returns for beginners.
Do not use complex rolls before basic base, hand control, and safe landing are reliable.
Greco/freestyle lift work requires technical coaching and safe mats.

sport_training_rules.rule: Teach top control, hip pressure, wrist control, base breakdown, and safe pressure before turn chains.
recommended_action: Use breakdown-to-control drills before near-fall or exposure attempts.
Choose folkstyle ride work or freestyle/Greco par terre work based on user style.
blocked_action: Do not chase turns before control is established.
Do not prescribe high-amplitude returns for beginners.

sport_training_rules.rule: Bottom escape starts with base, hand control, hip separation, and turn defense before complex rolls or reversals.
recommended_action: Teach base, hand control, stand-up, and hip-heist first.
Progress to switches, sit-outs, and ride-specific counters.
blocked_action: Avoid blind rolls for beginners or users with neck/back symptoms.

planning_rules.rule: Top/bottom training emphasis must match the user's wrestling style: folkstyle needs more riding, escapes, reversals, and mat returns; freestyle/Greco need more par terre exposure and defense.
recommended_action: Ask or infer style before choosing top/bottom emphasis.
Use general mat control when style is unknown.
blocked_action: Do not prescribe leg attacks in Greco-specific profiles.

teaching_progressions.learning_goal: Build safe top pressure, hip control, wrist control, and basic breakdown skill.
progression_signals: does not lose control chasing turn

teaching_progressions.learning_goal: Build base, hand control, stand-up, hip separation, and basic turn defense.

skill_assessments.summary: Assess top and bottom skill through control, base, pressure, escape sequence, style-specific scoring transfer, and symptom response.
hold_if: neck, shoulder, rib, low-back, hip, or knee symptoms worsen

minimum_evidence: can control top position safely for short rounds
can build base and stand up with hand control
can defend simple turns without panic
no worsening neck, shoulder, back, hip, or knee symptoms
promote_when: top pressure and bottom escape are stable under light resistance
uses safe mat return and landing behavior
level_transition_rules.backend_action: Unlock controlled top/bottom short-goes and simple ride/escape chains.
